title: Tampakan forms task force to prepare for ‘Super El Niño’

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — The municipal government of Tampakan in South Cotabato has created a task force to prepare for the possible effects of Super El Niño, including drought, water shortages and damage to agricultural production. Mayor Leonard T. Escobillo issued Executive Order No. 37, series of 2026, creating the Tampakan El Niño Response Task Force to lead planning, coordination and the implementation of measures to mitigate the effects of prolonged dry conditions. The task force will bring together representatives of the municipal government, national government agencies and barangays to coordinate preparations and responses to possible climate-related emergencies.
